title: COVID-19 Global Pandemic & Quarantine Lockdowns

title: NASA Perseverance Rover Lands on Mars

title: German Nuclear Power Plant Shutdown & Coal Offset

title: Discovery & Verification of the Higgs Boson Particle

title: 2008 Global Financial Crisis & Subprime Market Collapse

title: Introduction of the Apple iPhone & Touchscreen Smartphones

title: Rise of Modern Social Media Platforms (Facebook, YouTube)

title: September 11 Attacks & Global Aviation Security Overhaul
